# pve_task (Data Source)

Status of one task by UPID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_task" "example" {
node = "pve1"
upid = "UPID:pve1:000000:000000:000000:qmcreate:100:"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `upid` (String) Path parameter "upid".

### Optional

- `errors` (Boolean) Only list tasks with a status of ERROR. (default: 0)
- `limit` (Number) Only list this number of tasks. (default: 50)
- `since` (Number) Only list tasks since this UNIX epoch.
- `source` (String) List archived, active or all tasks. (default: archive) One of: `archive`, `active`, `all`.
- `start` (Number) List tasks beginning from this offset. (default: 0)
- `statusfilter` (String) List of Task States that should be returned.
- `typefilter` (String) Only list tasks of this type (e.g., vzstart, vzdump).
- `until` (Number) Only list tasks until this UNIX epoch.
- `userfilter` (String) Only list tasks from this user.
- `vmid` (Number) Only list tasks for this VM.

### Read-Only

- `entry` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid} (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<upid>.
- `recent` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/tasks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recent))
- `task` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--task))
